top_signals.title: Stocks Waver Ahead of Jobs Data; Trump to Meet Tech CEOs on AI
top_signals.summary: US equity futures and Treasuries struggle for direction ahead of labor market data and a slew of Fedspeak that may offer clues on the rate outlook. Nvidia, Anthropic and Palantir CEOs are slated to attend a lunch with President Trump to discuss AI risks. The US enacts import ban on some Canadian goods. Colin Purdie of Manulife joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss market opportunities amid rising yields. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dangote Dismisses Kenyan Court Ruling Pausing Refinery Build
top_signals.summary: Billionaire investor Aliko Dangote said a court order directing his company to hold off building a $16 billion oil refinery in the Kenyan coastal town of Lamu won’t derail the project, as the nation’s government unveiled plans for a new port in the area.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Smart Ring Maker Oura Becomes Latest Company to Delay IPO
top_signals.summary: Health and fitness ring-maker Oura Inc. became the latest company to delay a US initial public offering, citing uncertainty in the market for first-time share sales.
